text.tspan: etcd: one leader, a majority must agree (Raft)
• slow disk → leader elections → flaky API (use SSD)
• quota 2 GiB default (up to 8 GiB); full → read-only
• restore: etcdutl snapshot restore → new data dir
• Secrets live here → encryption at rest
A write is committed only when a majority has it on disk → strong consistency.
Every change gets a revision number → that is Kubernetes' resourceVersion, and watches are built on it.
